summary: Phase 1 Gamification backend verification — 20/20 pytest tests PASS (100%). All new endpoints (GET /api/badges, GET /api/streak, POST /api/badges/mark-seen), auto-award + streak bump on tracking/practice-log, no-streak-bump on attendance, regression on /api/tracking/me, /api/auth/me, /api/leaderboard, /api/dances, /api/classes, and user_badges cleanup on account deletion all verified live against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Also spot-checked live with Erin's account — badge catalog + progress values reflect her real completion data (4 completions → first_steps earned, progress 4/10 on getting_groovy, etc.).

minor.issue: For status=wishlist, the response returns `streak: null` (Python None). The response shape/schema is consistent (key is present), but if any client expects the same {current,longest,last_streak_date} shape, they'd need to null-guard. Not a bug, worth noting.

Empty body {} vs {ids: null} vs {ids: []} all behave the same (mark all). This matches the docstring but is not documented in an OpenAPI example — consider one integration example so clients don't send {ids: []} thinking it means 'nothing'.

action_items: No fixes required — all Phase 1 Gamification acceptance criteria are met.
Optional: consider returning the {current,longest,last_streak_date} shape (with current=0) instead of null for wishlist tracking POST responses to normalize client-side handling.
critical_code_review_comments: services/badges.py:bump_streak uses UTC day boundary as documented — timezone drift for users in far-west timezones is a known/accepted trade-off.

evaluate_badges catches all exceptions on insert_one (unique-index race) with bare `except Exception` — swallowing other DB errors silently. Consider narrowing to DuplicateKeyError (pymongo.errors) for robustness. Non-blocking for MVP.
The 'streak' key is present but null for wishlist upserts (routes/tracking.py line 73). Client TS types should mark it Optional/nullable.
user_to_out echoes current_streak/longest_streak/last_streak_date on every /auth/me — consistent with request spec.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a fresh TEST_gam_<uuid>@example.com user via /api/auth/register; delete-account test purges its own user; other test users remain but are prefixed TEST_gam_ for easy cleanup. A temporary class (session_label='TEST_gam class', date=2020-01-01) is created by fixture and cleaned up after the session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 gamification is green. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_gamification.py can be re-run at any time — it's fully self-contained (registers fresh users per test) and uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Idempotency of same-day streak bumps is covered. If tests are re-run and a specific user's badges leak between test cases, check that db.user_badges has its unique (user_id, badge_id) index (see backend/services/startup.py:53).
